title: Session A · Full body
notes: Back after three weeks: weights are where you last lifted them. Every set ends with 2 reps left in the tank. Short on time or energy? Do pairs A and B and stop; that counts.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.note: A1. Back to 35 after three weeks off; it goes up again once this feels easy. Heels down, chest up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.note: A2. 30s. One arm, other hand and knee on the bench.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: B1. 35s. Flat bench, elbows about 45° from your sides.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.note: B2. Bodyweight. Squeeze at the top for a second.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: C1. 20s. Seated, bench upright, palms facing each other.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.note: Finisher. Slow. Low back stays flat on the floor.
